subject: pathology
title: Osteogenesis Imperfecta, Achondroplasia, Osteopetrosis, Osteoporosis, and Paget Disease

steps.tx: Osteogenesis imperfecta brittles bones through type one collagen mutations, blue sclerae, dentinogenesis imperfecta, hearing loss, and fractures varying lethal perinatal to mild adult. That collagen fragility is **osteogenesis imperfecta**. This point is tested repeatedly because it changes everyday bedside decisions. Examiners return to it because it separates careful clinicians from guesswork.
steps.say: Blue sclerae, fragile bones, imperfect teeth: osteogenesis imperfecta is type one collagen failing.

steps.tx: Achondroplasia shortens limbs rhizomelically from FGFR3 gain restraining endochondral growth, normal intelligence, midface hypoplasia, and foramen magnum vigilance in infants. That receptor dwarfism is **achondroplasia of FGFR3 activation**. Bedside recognition of this pattern saves time, blood, and unnecessary investigation. Students should anchor this fact before moving to rarer causes and exceptions.
steps.say: Rhizomelic shortening with normal intellect is achondroplasia; watch infant foramen magnum compression.

steps.tx: Osteopetrosis marble bones fail resorption as osteoclasts falter, bone denser yet brittle, marrow crowded into anaemia, nerves compressed through unmodelled foramina. That dense failure is **osteopetrosis (marble bone disease)**. In practice this distinction decides the next test, treatment, or referral made. That is why this detail earns its place in every examination and ward round.
steps.say: Bone too dense can still break and starve marrow; osteopetrosis is resorption failure, not strength.

vis.caption: Osteopetrosis with marble dense bone and modelling failure.

steps.tx: Osteoporosis thins trabeculae and cortex with normal mineralisation until vertebral and hip fragility fractures, DEXA T scores and FRAX prescribing antiresorptives. That porous fragility is **osteoporosis**. Remembering it prevents the commonest errors made with this presentation entirely. The clinical payoff comes from applying it early, before complications accumulate further.
steps.say: Osteoporosis is less bone, normally mineralised; a fragility fracture diagnoses it clinically outright.

vis.caption: Osteoporosis bone loss and fragility fracture patterns.

steps.tx: Paget disease of bone cycles osteoclast storms into mosaic lamellar chaos, enlarging skull, pelvis, femur with pain, deafness, high output failure, and rare osteosarcoma. That mosaic remodelling is **Paget disease of bone**. This point is tested repeatedly because it changes everyday bedside decisions.
steps.say: Enlarging hat size, mosaic bone, sky high alkaline phosphatase: Paget disease remodelling out of rhythm.

vis.caption: Paget disease of bone with mosaic remodelling and enlarged bone.

steps.tx: Bisphosphonates suppress pagetic and osteoporotic resorption by poisoning osteoclast function, dental review and calcium vitamin D preceding therapy. That antiresorptive family is **bisphosphonates in metabolic bone disease**. Examiners return to it because it separates careful clinicians from guesswork. Bedside recognition of this pattern saves time, blood, and unnecessary investigation.
steps.say: Bisphosphonates quiet osteoclasts in Paget disease and osteoporosis; check teeth and calcium first.

steps.tx: Rickets and osteomalacia soften unmineralised osteoid from vitamin D, phosphate, or renal disease, Looser zones and bowed bones separating them from osteoporosis density loss. That soft bone is **rickets and osteomalacia of defective mineralisation**. Students should anchor this fact before moving to rarer causes and exceptions.
steps.say: Soft unmineralised bone bows and aches; osteoporosis is normally mineralised bone simply too little.

steps.tx: Bone health workup unites calcium phosphate ALP vitamin D PTH, myeloma exclusion in older fracture patients, and secondary cause hunting before labelling senile osteoporosis. That completeness is **secondary osteoporosis evaluation**. In practice this distinction decides the next test, treatment, or referral made.
steps.say: Every fragility fracture earns myeloma, thyroid, parathyroid, and steroid questions before age takes blame.
